decision: not shipped: inconclusive. The difference is -0.3 points but its lower bound (-2.7) is below the -2 point margin, and ADR-0094 clause 25 treats insufficient power as inconclusive, never equivalent. The limit never bound (no attempt exceeded 587 output tokens), so a decision needs either more power or an owner tradeoff that a never-binding safety bound does not need a completion margin.
deviations: the tiebreak judge is gpt-6.1-sol, not claude-sonnet-5-5 (the Anthropic test key has no credit), so every verdict is exploratory
no SDK retries in the evaluation ceiling
hypothesis: An explicit 32,000-token output limit on chat turns (the evaluation's limit) causes no completion regression against production's unlimited output (the model maximum, 128,000).
metric: paired whole-task success on precision-v2.1 (oracle plus judged reply), template-cluster bootstrap; criterion: lower 95% bound of cap minus base at least -2 points and no safety regression (ADR-0094 clauses 21-22)
n: 120 scenarios x 5 repetitions per arm, 600 complete pairs; gpt-6-luna, effort low; arms base (128,000), cap (32,000), sent (the untrusted-result sentence), randomized order per scenario and repetition

notes: this note was written by hand from that report; max_output_tokens_per_attempt is the largest output_tokens of any attempt per arm in the private transcript
